prompt.project_info: Create a warm luxury goddess-inspired portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman in a modern apartment.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair skin, light eyes, soft makeup, a relaxed confident slight smile, and long straight platinum-blonde hair with a middle part. She wears a white halter-style fashion bodysuit with a flattering deep V neckline, thin gold waist detail, sheer white wrap skirt, gold leaf crown, gold coin choker, arm cuffs, and coin waist chain.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered balanced vertical mid-thigh-to-head portrait at eye level, subject upright with relaxed shoulders, warm modern apartment, neutral curtains, white wall panels, round pendant lights, dining table, sofa, and wood floor in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ambient indoor lighting, soft frontal key, subtle side fill, warm ceiling pendants, soft background separation, elegant white-and-gold luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K/8K-detail portrait, 85mm lens, f/1.8, sharp subject, realistic skin and fabric texture, natural shadows, warm neutral grade, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a warm photorealistic luxury fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with fair skin, light eyes, soft makeup, a relaxed confident slight smile, and long straight platinum-blonde hair with a middle part. She stands upright with relaxed shoulders and wears a white halter-style fashion bodysuit with a flattering deep V neckline, thin gold waist detail, sheer white wrap skirt, gold leaf crown, gold coin choker, gold arm cuffs, and gold coin waist chain. Compose a centered balanced vertical mid-thigh-to-head portrait at eye level inside a modern apartment with neutral curtains, white wall panels, round pendant lights, a dining table, sofa, and wood floor. Use warm ambient light, soft frontal key, subtle side fill, realistic skin and fabric, 85mm f/1.8 perspective, soft background separation, natural shadows, and warm white-and-gold grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
